---
title: "QoL six-month landmark: proportional-odds check"
subtitle: "Common and threshold-specific treatment odds ratios, adjusted and unadjusted"
format: html
---

- Frequentist graphical check only; not a replacement for the Bayesian estimands.
- Positive log odds ratios mean greater odds of a worse outcome under ctDNA.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(rms)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

landmark_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "03-quality-of-life", "02-six-month-landmark", "results"
)
results_dir <- file.path(landmark_dir, "proportional-odds-check")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

completed_datasets <- map(seq_len(config$imputation$m_main), \(index) {
  readRDS(file.path(
    landmark_dir, "imputations", sprintf("completed-%02d.rds", index)
  ))
})
```

## Per-imputation estimates

```{r}
#| label: fit-threshold-models
#| include: false

models <- tibble(
  model = c("adjusted", "unadjusted"),
  covariates = list(c("tx", "rcs(baseline_q30, 4)"), "tx"),
  m = c(config$imputation$m_main, config$imputation$m_supporting)
)

estimates <- models |>
  pmap(\(model, covariates, m) {
    seq_len(m) |>
      map(\(index) {
        data <- completed_datasets[[index]] |>
          mutate(y_landmark = ordered(y_landmark, levels = 1:8))

        common_fit <- lrm(
          reformulate(covariates, response = "y_landmark"),
          data = data,
          x = TRUE,
          y = TRUE
        )

        binary_estimates <- 1:7 |>
          map(\(threshold) {
            binary_data <- data |>
              mutate(binary_worse = as.integer(as.integer(y_landmark) > threshold))
            binary_fit <- lrm(
              reformulate(covariates, response = "binary_worse"),
              data = binary_data,
              x = TRUE,
              y = TRUE
            )

            tibble(
              threshold = threshold,
              comparison = paste0("Y > ", threshold),
              estimate = unname(coef(binary_fit)["tx"]),
              variance = unname(vcov(binary_fit)["tx", "tx"])
            )
          }) |>
          list_rbind()

        tibble(
          threshold = NA_integer_,
          comparison = "Common proportional-odds effect",
          estimate = unname(coef(common_fit)["tx"]),
          variance = unname(vcov(common_fit)["tx", "tx"])
        ) |>
          bind_rows(binary_estimates) |>
          mutate(model = model, imputation = index, .before = 1)
      }) |>
      list_rbind()
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

write_parquet(estimates, file.path(results_dir, "imputation-estimates.parquet"))
```

## Pooling with Rubin's rules

```{r}
#| label: pool-estimates
#| include: false

pooled <- estimates |>
  group_by(model, comparison) |>
  summarise(
    threshold = first(threshold),
    imputations = n(),
    q_bar = mean(estimate),
    u_bar = mean(variance),
    between = var(estimate),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    total = u_bar + (1 + 1 / imputations) * between,
    degrees_freedom = if_else(
      is.finite(between) & between > 0,
      (imputations - 1) * (1 + u_bar / ((1 + 1 / imputations) * between))^2,
      Inf
    ),
    critical_value = if_else(
      is.finite(degrees_freedom),
      qt(0.975, df = degrees_freedom),
      qnorm(0.975)
    ),
    log_odds_ratio = q_bar,
    standard_error = sqrt(total),
    conf_low = q_bar - critical_value * standard_error,
    conf_high = q_bar + critical_value * standard_error,
    odds_ratio = exp(q_bar),
    odds_ratio_low = exp(conf_low),
    odds_ratio_high = exp(conf_high),
    order = coalesce(threshold, 0L)
  ) |>
  arrange(model, order) |>
  select(
    model, comparison, threshold, log_odds_ratio, standard_error,
    conf_low, conf_high, odds_ratio, odds_ratio_low, odds_ratio_high,
    imputations, order
  )

write_parquet(pooled, file.path(results_dir, "pooled-estimates.parquet"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-adjusted-proportional-odds-check
#| tbl-cap: "Adjusted model: pooled common and threshold-specific treatment odds ratios for a worse six-month outcome"
#| echo: false

pooled |>
  filter(model == "adjusted") |>
  select(
    comparison, odds_ratio, odds_ratio_low, odds_ratio_high,
    log_odds_ratio, conf_low, conf_high
  ) |>
  kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-unadjusted-proportional-odds-check
#| tbl-cap: "Unadjusted model: pooled common and threshold-specific treatment odds ratios for a worse six-month outcome"
#| echo: false

pooled |>
  filter(model == "unadjusted") |>
  select(
    comparison, odds_ratio, odds_ratio_low, odds_ratio_high,
    log_odds_ratio, conf_low, conf_high
  ) |>
  kable()
```

## Figures

- Black: threshold-specific effects. Grey: common effect, repeated per threshold.
- Dashed line: zero (adjusted), common estimate (unadjusted).

```{r}
#| label: threshold-plots
#| include: false

# Called once per model (adjusted and unadjusted).
threshold_plot <- function(model_name, reference_line, x_label) {
  model_pooled <- pooled |>
    filter(model == model_name)

  binary_pooled <- model_pooled |>
    filter(!is.na(threshold)) |>
    mutate(comparison = factor(comparison, levels = rev(comparison)))
  common_pooled <- model_pooled |>
    filter(is.na(threshold))
  common_repeated <- binary_pooled |>
    mutate(
      log_odds_ratio = common_pooled$log_odds_ratio,
      conf_low = common_pooled$conf_low,
      conf_high = common_pooled$conf_high
    )

  ggplot() +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = reference_line,
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = reference_line_colour
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = binary_pooled,
      aes(y = comparison, xmin = conf_low, xmax = conf_high),
      width = 0.12,
      orientation = "y",
      position = position_nudge(y = 0.08),
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = binary_pooled,
      aes(x = log_odds_ratio, y = comparison),
      position = position_nudge(y = 0.08),
      size = 2.5,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = common_repeated,
      aes(y = comparison, xmin = conf_low, xmax = conf_high),
      width = 0.12,
      orientation = "y",
      position = position_nudge(y = -0.08),
      colour = "grey55"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = common_repeated,
      aes(x = log_odds_ratio, y = comparison),
      position = position_nudge(y = -0.08),
      size = 2.5,
      colour = "grey55"
    ) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = "Binary threshold") +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
}

unadjusted_common <- pooled |>
  filter(model == "unadjusted", is.na(threshold)) |>
  pull(log_odds_ratio)

adjusted_plot <- threshold_plot(
  "adjusted",
  reference_line = 0,
  x_label = "Treatment log odds ratio for a worse outcome"
)
unadjusted_plot <- threshold_plot(
  "unadjusted",
  reference_line = unadjusted_common,
  x_label = "Unadjusted treatment log odds ratio for a worse outcome"
)

save_figure(
  adjusted_plot,
  file.path(results_dir, "adjusted-common-vs-binary-log-odds-ratios.png"),
  height = 5.5
)
save_figure(
  unadjusted_plot,
  file.path(results_dir, "unadjusted-common-vs-binary-log-odds-ratios.png"),
  height = 5.5
)
```
